hci.name: Human-Computer Interaction (HCI)

hci.beginnerExplanation: HCI investigates the intersection of computer science, behavioural psychology, and design to create intuitive, accessible interfaces.
sampleResearchQuestions: How does visual cognitive load affect decision confidence in high-stakes dashboards?
What interface adaptations reduce latency frustration for neurodivergent learners?

res-ethics-01.title: Research Integrity & Academic Ethics Fundamentals
res-ethics-01.summary: Core principles of research integrity: authorship ethics, participant consent, and data transparency.
res-ethics-01.contentOrUrl: Research ethics establish the foundational pact between science and society. Key pillars include: 1) Informed consent without coercion, 2) Data fabrication and falsification zero-tolerance, 3) Fair authorship attributing significant intellectual contributions, and 4) Full conflict of interest disclosure.
res-ethics-01.authorOrEditor: Dr. Eleanor Vance, ResWave Ethics Chair

res-lit-01.title: Systematic Literature Reviews & Spotting the Research Gap
res-lit-01.category: Literature review and identifying a research gap
res-lit-01.summary: A methodical 5-step checklist for synthesising literature and isolating an authentic, defensible research gap.
res-lit-01.contentOrUrl: Checklist: 1. Formulate specific search strings across indexed repositories. 2. Establish strict inclusion and exclusion criteria. 3. Construct a synthesis matrix extracting methodology, sample size, and limitations. 4. Identify contradictions or unexamined contexts (the Gap). 5. Formulate your research question directly addressing that void.

res-method-01.title: Formulating Testable Hypotheses & Methodology Selection
res-method-01.summary: Distinguishing exploratory questions from falsifiable hypotheses and matching them to appropriate empirical methods.
res-method-01.contentOrUrl: A robust research hypothesis must be directional, measurable, and falsifiable. When choosing methods: Qualitative approaches uncover 'why' and 'how' through thematic analysis; Quantitative methods test relationships and variance; Mixed methods triangulate both for comprehensive validity.

res-pub-01.title: Navigating Peer Review, Revisions & Rebuttals
res-pub-01.category: Publication process, peer review, revisions and responding to reviewers
res-pub-01.summary: How to structure courteous, evidence-backed rebuttal letters and manage major revision requests constructively.
res-pub-01.contentOrUrl: Reviewers are your paper's first rigorous readers. Golden rules for rebuttals: 1) Thank reviewers for constructive critiques, 2) Quote the exact comment followed by your direct answer and line references, 3) Never argue defensively—demonstrate empirical improvements with added experiments or clarifications.
